name: Biomuse
tagline: Moving countries, and the money that comes with it

categories.name: Visas & Residency
categories.description: Residency and work routes worth understanding — what each requires, what it costs, and who actually qualifies.

categories.name: Housing
categories.description: Renting and buying in a new country, from short-term landings to a first mortgage without local credit history.

categories.name: Banking & Money
categories.description: Accounts, transfers, private banking and building a credit file from nothing.

categories.name: Mortgages
categories.description: Borrowing across borders — buy-to-let for non-residents, first-time buyers, and lending with a thin file.

categories.name: Tax
categories.description: Filing and reporting obligations that follow you across borders, and the ones that catch people out.

categories.name: Work & Relocation
categories.description: Roles that sponsor, what they pay, and the practical reality of landing in a new city.

disclosureText: This guide is general information, not legal, immigration, tax or financial advice. Rules, fees, thresholds and eligibility change frequently and apply differently to each person. Verify current requirements with the relevant official source and take advice from a qualified professional before acting.
